How it works

From tape measure to finished window.

Do it all by email or WhatsApp, from your home or office. You can save with self-measuring, or have us measure for you.

  1. Measure

    Measure your own windows for an extra 10% discount, using our “How to measure” guide.

    Or we measure for you: a cash call-out fee from R300, refunded when you place your order.

  2. Quote

    Send your details by form, email or WhatsApp. Your free quote arrives by email within 3 hours.

  3. Deposit

    Accept the quote, we confirm your official order, and you pay the deposit.

  4. Verify

    Once the deposit is in, a representative visits to verify your measurements (Durban and surrounding areas).

  5. Install

    We deliver to your doorstep or install at your home or office. Every blind gets a double quality check.

Custom-made means no returns. Measuring yourself? You can ask for Self-measuring Insurance, which costs 3% of your order total.

Family business, since1995

Built on honesty, exceptional service and unbeatable prices.

Blind Specialist began in 1995 with cleaning and repairing blinds. It grew into an agency for top manufacturers, selling custom-made new blinds. We're a family enterprise, and we're the top agent for our manufacturers: every blind sold falls under their full guarantee, administered by us.

3-year carry-in guarantee

Found a factory fault? Send us a photo. We'll tell you whether it goes back to the factory or whether a technician can fix it on site (within 50 km of our offices).

Double quality check

All blinds undergo a double quality check before they reach you.

Happy customers

We've done blinds for companies including University of Zululand and Air Products Pinetown, and you're welcome to phone them for a reference.
